# Labels

<!-- auto-generated by cmd/docgen — do not edit -->

Labels are free-form tags on Jira issues. Unlike components, labels are not
project-scoped — the same label can appear in any project.

## jira label list

List labels available in the Jira instance (or a project's current labels).

**Alias:** `ls`

### Usage

```
jira label list [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project` | `-p` | Filter to labels currently used in a project |
| `--search` | | Search by label prefix |
| `--limit` | `-L` | Maximum labels to display (default 50) |

### Inherited Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--context` | `-c` | Active Jira context name |
| `--json` | | Output in JSON format |
| `--yaml` | | Output in YAML format |

### Examples

```bash
jira label list
jira label list --search "back"
jira label list --project MYPROJ --json
```

---

## Adding and Removing Labels on Issues

Labels on individual issues are managed with `jira issue edit`:

```bash
# Add labels
jira issue edit MYPROJ-42 --label backend --label api

# Remove labels
jira issue edit MYPROJ-42 --remove-label backend

# Set labels (replaces existing — via --custom workaround)
jira issue edit MYPROJ-42 --custom labels='["api","frontend"]'
```
